Reference / mail/smtp_reading

mail/smtp_reading#

Reading one SMTP reply from a stream, keeping the bytes read past it.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let read = await SmtpReplyReading(socket).read();
read.reply().code();                 // 220
let next = await SmtpReplyReading(origin: socket, prefix: read.remainder()).read();

Description#

Reading one SMTP reply from a stream, keeping the bytes read past it.

One read at a time per stream. A read that fails part way may have consumed input: the session is then over; do not retry it.
